Name: Bigger Crafting Cost and Stronger Monsters 1.1
Author: Daddyfatflab
Description:
I love Stardew Valley, it has a special place in my library as a game I play to relax and enjoy! Despite that, however, I find that some parts of the game were too easy. 

I designed this mod to modify the crafting recipe value cost, as well as the monsters health.

Most if not all crafting recipes are probably higher than you'll ever want, thats okay because its my personal preference and I dont mind if you tweak it yourself or leave suggestions. 

The main reason the cost is so high is to discourage the mass-money-making that comes with crafting.. say 10 crystalariums or 20 Kegs in the later game! 
I instead prefer the casual, few of everything and not own everything in the game and millions of gold in the first year or so.

If you dont like my values, you can leave suggestions or just use the monster modification file!  
[b]
INSTALATION

[/b]1. Download.
2. Extract Content folder to Stardewvalley game folder located in your Steamapps/common directory
3. Launch and play! No special launcher needed. 

[b][u]Future Plans
[/u][/b]Adjust Monster Damage as well
Decrease overall item worth
